terms.gloss: inwardly, deep within, far within; thoroughly
evidence: Cic. Verr. 2.5.68: saxum penitus excīsum (Lewis & Short)
Caes. BG 6.9: Suēvōs penitus ad extrēmōs fīnēs sē recēpisse (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: Suēvōs penitus ad extrēmōs fīnēs sē recēpisse
phrases.english: that the Suebi had withdrawn far within, to their furthest borders
